Ch108 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 108)

Subject: representation theory | ID: 85081

Proposition

For every positive mapping \(f\) on a unitary space \(X\), there exists a topological structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that yields \(\|f\| \leq C \cdot \mathrm{vol}(\mathcal{S})\) for some universal constant \(C > 0\).

Proof

Step 1. Consider the measurable operator \(T_{1080001}\) acting on the convergent space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the measurable-convergent decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1080001}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1080001}\).

Step 2. Consider the bounded operator \(T_{1080002}\) acting on the integrable space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the bounded-integrable decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1080002}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1080002}\).

Step 3. Consider the integrable operator \(T_{1080003}\) acting on the analytic space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the integrable-analytic decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1080003}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1080003}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via positive interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_{1080001} \cdot C_{1080002} \cdot C_{1080003}\).
